_comment: Fit spec for tools/creature_fit.py and tools/blender/creature_fit_blender.py (2026-09-30). Paths under 'armory' are relative to the live LOTRLOME_Armory module. The hammer layout is the crafting system's: tools/oneoff/add_hill_troll_hammer_items.py writes handle length 350.96 cm with piece_offset 95 (the grip 80.5 cm above the butt) and a 69.63 cm head seated flush on the handle's top; each piece mesh is centred on its origin with its length along Z (tools/oneoff/export_hill_troll_hammer.py). The held weapon's frame is the grip bone's frame, pieces along +Z (measured on vanilla two-handed clips, docs/features/troll-race.md 'Fine tuning').
_offhand: The off grip rides 0.60 m below the main grip: the troll's closed fists span 0.54 (right, -0.225..+0.313 on the shaft) and 0.56 m (left, -0.209..+0.355), so 0.58 m keeps the fists apart and 0.02 m more is a gap; the left fist's lower edge then sits at the butt (-0.805). Vanilla's 0.14 m is one human fist plus a gap. The arm chain is the human skeleton's.
